proposals.before: Zhou She, whose courtesy name was Shengyi, came from Ancheng in Runan and was the eighth-generation descendant of Yan, who had served Jin as Left Director of the Imperial Secretariat.
proposals.after: Zhou She, whose courtesy name was Shengyi, came from Ancheng in Runan and was the eighth-generation descendant of Yan, who had served Jin as Left Grand Master for Splendid Happiness.
proposals.reason: 左光祿大夫 is the Guanglu dafu honorific rank, not Director of the Imperial Secretariat; the idiomatic English invents the wrong office.

proposals.before: Zhou She, styled Shengyi, was a native of Ancheng in Runan, the eighth-generation descendant of Yan, Left Director of the Imperial Secretariat of Jin.
proposals.after: Zhou She, styled Shengyi, was a native of Ancheng in Runan, the eighth-generation descendant of Yan, Left Grand Master for Splendid Happiness of Jin.
proposals.reason: Literal English repeats the same mistranslation of 左光祿大夫 as Director of the Imperial Secretariat.

proposals.before: In the Jianwu era, the Wei man Wu Bao came south and returned; he had Confucian learning, and the Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs Jiang Shi invited Bao to lecture.
proposals.after: In the Jianwu era, the Wei man Wu Bao returned south; he had Confucian learning, and the Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs Jiang Shi invited Bao to lecture.
proposals.reason: 南歸 means returned/came south once, not the doubled motion 'came south and returned'.

proposals.before: He was reappointed General of the Right Swift Cavalry and served concurrently as acting Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
proposals.after: He was reappointed General of the Right Swift Cavalry and served concurrently as acting Supervisor of the Heir Apparent's Household.
proposals.reason: 太子詹事 is the Supervisor of the Heir Apparent's Household, not Grand Tutor (太傅); preceding context already uses Supervisor.

proposals.before: He was transferred to General of the Right Swift Cavalry and acted as Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
proposals.after: He was transferred to General of the Right Swift Cavalry and acted as Supervisor of the Heir Apparent's Household.
proposals.reason: Literal English likewise mistranslates 太子詹事 as Grand Tutor instead of Supervisor of the Heir Apparent's Household.

proposals.before: An edict read: "Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent and Chief Rectifier of Yuzhou, She, has died suddenly, and my heart is full of grief.
proposals.after: An edict read: "Supervisor of the Heir Apparent's Household and Chief Rectifier of Yuzhou, She, has died suddenly, and my heart is full of grief.
proposals.reason: Same office mistranslation of 太子詹事 as Grand Tutor in the edict opening.

proposals.before: An edict said: "Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent and Chief Rectifier of Yuzhou She has suddenly met with death; my heart is pierced with sorrow.
proposals.after: An edict said: "Supervisor of the Heir Apparent's Household and Chief Rectifier of Yuzhou She has suddenly met with death; my heart is pierced with sorrow.
proposals.reason: Literal English repeats the 太子詹事 to Grand Tutor error.

proposals.before: When he died he had no wife or concubine at home and no fields or house abroad. His two sons were left alone in poverty—a austerity that surpassed the stern worthies of old.
proposals.after: When he died he had no wife or concubine at home and no fields or house abroad. His two sons were left alone in poverty—an austerity that surpassed the stern worthies of old.
proposals.reason: Grammatical error: indefinite article before austerity must be an, not a.

proposals.before: His grandfather Changzong was Aide on the March of the Song High Ancestor's hegemonial headquarters.
proposals.after: His grandfather Changzong was Acting Aide of the Song High Ancestor's hegemonial headquarters.
proposals.reason: 行參軍 is an acting or staff aide post; on the March is a corrupted rendering unrelated to the Chinese.

proposals.before: He had also mastered the writings of the hundred schools of thought and could draw on them all to avoid forbidden names.
proposals.after: He had also comprehensively mastered the hundred clan surnames and used them all for taboo avoidance.
proposals.reason: 百氏 here means the hundred clan surnames used for name-taboo avoidance (避諱), not the hundred schools of thought (百家).

proposals.before: He also mastered comprehensively the hundred schools, all of which he used for taboo avoidance.
proposals.after: He also comprehensively mastered the hundred clan surnames, all of which he used for taboo avoidance.
proposals.reason: 百氏 denotes clan surnames in a taboo-avoidance context, not philosophical schools.

proposals.before: If after my death this too will be an item in the tradition."
proposals.after: If after I die, this too will be an item in the tradition."
proposals.reason: The literal English is ungrammatical; 若吾亡後 is temporal 'when/if after I die', not a broken conditional.

proposals.before: In the rites of seeing one off at the end, encoffining is set for a fixed day; wealthy houses with moistened roofs sometimes do it in half a day. Garments, covers, coffin, and outer coffin—taking speed as glory; kin, servants, and retainers each think of rest and return.
proposals.after: In the rites of seeing one off at the end, encoffining is set for a fixed day; wealthy households sometimes do it in half a day. Garments, covers, coffin, and outer coffin—taking speed as glory; kin, servants, and retainers each think of rest and return.
proposals.reason: 潤屋 is an idiom for wealthy households; 'moistened roofs' is an obscuring calque.

proposals.before: When the High Ancestor ascended the throne, he was appointed Secretariat Attendant and transferred to General Who Establishes Might, Adviser to the Rear General, Rectifier of his native district, and Left Assistant Director of the Secretariat.
proposals.after: When the High Ancestor ascended the throne, he was appointed Secretariat Attendant and transferred to General Who Establishes Might, Adviser to the Rear Army, Rectifier of his native district, and Left Assistant Director of the Secretariat.
proposals.reason: 後軍 is the Rear Army, not a 'Rear General'; the idiomatic rendering already has Rear Army.

proposals.before: The texts of the Orchid Pavilion and Stone Chamber were exhausted for tent canopies.
proposals.after: The texts of the Orchid Terrace and Stone Chamber were exhausted for tent canopies.
proposals.reason: 蘭臺 denotes the Orchid Terrace (imperial archives), not the Orchid Pavilion (蘭亭).

proposals.before: Finally Zhou She, Gentleman Attendant of the Palace Secretariat, and Yuan Yuling were also appointed to take part in deliberation.
proposals.after: Finally Zhou She, Gentleman Attendant of the Palace Secretariat, and Yu Yuling were also appointed to take part in deliberation.
proposals.reason: 庾 is surnamed Yu, not Yuan; the packet English misspells 庾於陵.

proposals.before: Finally Zhou She, Gentleman Attendant of the Palace Secretariat, and Yuan Yuling were again ordered to participate in consultation and knowledge.
proposals.after: Finally Zhou She, Gentleman Attendant of the Palace Secretariat, and Yu Yuling were again ordered to participate in consultation and knowledge.
proposals.reason: 庾 is surnamed Yu, not Yuan; the packet English misspells 庾於陵.

proposals.before: The Zhou spoke of three thousand rites, reaching the full traditional count;
proposals.after: The Zhou era counted three thousand rites, taking that traditional full number;
proposals.reason: Chinese 周代三千，舉其盈數 states the Zhou-era tally; it does not say that Zhou 'spoke of' the rites.

proposals.before: Is this not what is meant by matching Zhou in achievement and in splendor!
proposals.after: Is this not what is called equal in achievement and comparable in splendor!
proposals.reason: Chinese 豈所謂齊功比美者歟 does not name Zhou; the idiomatic English inserts 'Zhou' without source support.

proposals.before: This spring, as Your Majesty's carriage prepares to lead the armies in person, I searched through the military rites and reviewed their articles and regulations — all are comprehensive and complete.
proposals.after: Since this spring Your Majesty's carriage is to lead the Six Armies in person, the military rites have been searched and their articles reviewed — none are incomplete.
proposals.reason: Chinese 自今春輿駕將親六師 begins with 'since this spring' and does not explicitly mark 'I' as the searcher; the idiomatic version drops 自 and forces a first-person agent.

proposals.before: Though this is not the same as the mound at Qufu, it may serve in some measure.
proposals.after: Though this differs from the case of Qinqiu (Sleeping Mound), it may serve as a rough likeness.
proposals.reason: 寢丘 is the poor fief Qinqiu associated with Sunshu Ao, not Qufu (曲阜); the idiomatic rendering invents the wrong place name.

proposals.before: Though the matter differs from sleeping on a mound, it may serve as a rough likeness.
proposals.after: Though the matter differs from Qinqiu, it may serve as a rough likeness.
proposals.reason: 寢丘 is a place-name (Qinqiu), not the act of sleeping on a mound; the literal calque obscures the allusion.

proposals.before: raise a mountain nine ren high and you regret even one basket spilled.
proposals.after: raise a mountain many ren high and you regret even one basket spilled.
proposals.reason: Chinese 累仞 does not state nine; 'nine ren' imports the related classical tag without being in this sentence.

proposals.before: I, weeping through tears like snow, answered: "The enlightened meaning of 'long or short life,' Yannian and Wusheng's refined words — I have often heard them;
proposals.after: I answered, wiping away tears: "The enlightened meaning of long and short life, and the refined words of Yan and Wu — I have often heard them;
proposals.reason: 雪泣 means weeping or wiping tears, not tears like snow; 延吳 is not the personal names Yannian and Wusheng.

decisions.after: Zhou She, whose courtesy name was Shengyi, came from Ancheng in Runan and was the eighth-generation descendant of Zhou Yi, who had served Jin as Left Grand Master for Splendid Happiness.
decisions.reason: 左光祿大夫 is indeed Left Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, but the proposal leaves 顗 mistranscribed as Yan; the ancestor is Zhou Yi.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 晉左光祿大夫顗之八世孫也

decisions.after: Zhou She, styled Shengyi, was a native of Ancheng in Runan and an eighth-generation descendant of Zhou Yi, the Jin Left Grand Master for Splendid Happiness.
decisions.reason: The office correction is right, but 顗 is Yi, not Yan. The revision corrects both the ancestor's name and 左光祿大夫.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 晉左光祿大夫顗之八世孫也

decisions.reason: 南歸 is one southward return or migration; the proposal correctly removes the duplicated motion in 'came south and returned.'
太子詹事 is Supervisor of the Heir Apparent's Household, whereas Grand Tutor would be 太子太傅; the proposed office title is correct.
The literal field makes the same office error: 太子詹事 denotes the Supervisor of the Heir Apparent's Household, not a Grand Tutor.
The edict explicitly styles She 太子詹事; replacing the unrelated Grand Tutor title with Supervisor of the Heir Apparent's Household is accurate.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 太子詹事、豫州大中正捨

decisions.reason: 太子詹事 is correctly rendered as Supervisor of the Heir Apparent's Household in the proposed literal replacement.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 太子詹事、豫州大中正捨

decisions.after: When he died he had no wife or concubine at home and no fields or house abroad. His two sons were left alone in poverty, and his austerity surpassed that of the stern worthies of old.
decisions.reason: The article must be corrected, but 'an austerity that surpassed the stern worthies' compares a quality directly with people. The revision makes the comparison grammatical.
行參軍 is a staff aide post. The proposed Acting Aide removes the false phrase 'on the March' and correctly attaches the post to the hegemonial headquarters.

decisions.after: He also possessed comprehensive knowledge of the various clans and took care to avoid all their taboo names.
decisions.reason: 百氏 in this personnel context means the various clans, but the proposal's 'hundred clan surnames' is overly literal and 'used them all' obscures that he avoided their taboo names.

decisions.after: He also had comprehensive knowledge of the various clans and avoided the taboo names of them all.
decisions.reason: The proposal correctly rejects 'hundred schools,' but 百氏 refers to the various clans and 皆爲避諱 says that he observed their name taboos, not that he used surnames as a tool.

decisions.after: After my death, this too will be an incident recorded in my biography."
decisions.reason: The proposal notices the broken syntax but retains the awkward 'If after I die' and mistranslates 傳 as 'tradition.' The sentence anticipates an incident in his biography.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 若吾亡後，亦是傳中一事

decisions.reason: 潤屋 invokes wealth adorning a house and modifies 豪家; 'wealthy households' correctly replaces the misleading literal calque 'moistened roofs.'
後軍 is the Rear Army command qualified by 諮議參軍, not a person titled Rear General; the proposed wording corrects the object of 'Adviser.'

decisions.after: The texts of the Orchid Terrace and Stone Chamber were entirely used up as tent coverings.
decisions.reason: 蘭臺 is correctly identified as the Orchid Terrace, but 'were exhausted for tent canopies' remains awkward English; 用盡於帷蓋 means the texts were used up as coverings.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 蘭臺石室之文，用盡於帷蓋

decisions.reason: 庾 is the surname Yu, so 庾於陵 is Yu Yuling. The proposal accurately removes the erroneous Yuan spelling from the idiomatic field.

decisions.after: Finally Zhou She, Gentleman Attendant of the Palace Secretariat, and Yu Yuling were again ordered to participate in the deliberations.
decisions.reason: Yu Yuling is the correct name, but 'participate in consultation and knowledge' remains an unnatural calque of 豫參知. The revision renders the coordinated appointment clearly.

decisions.after: In the Zhou, the rites were said to number three thousand, a round total;
decisions.reason: The original wrongly says Zhou 'spoke,' but the proposal remains awkward. 周代 supplies the era and 舉其盈數 explains three thousand as a cited round total.
The immediately preceding quotation names Zhou, so Zhou is the understood comparator of 齊功比美. The original makes that ellipsis explicit and is more natural than the proposal's comparatorless wording.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 其有繼周，雖百世可知。豈所謂齊功比美者歟

decisions.after: Since this spring, as Your Majesty has prepared to lead the Six Armies in person, I have searched the military rites and reviewed their articles and regulations; all are comprehensive and complete.
decisions.reason: 自今春 and 六師 support 'since this spring' and 'Six Armies,' but the proposal's passive clauses and mixed tense are awkward. The memorial context permits the implied first-person agent.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 自今春輿駕將親六師，搜尋軍禮，閱其條章

decisions.reason: 寢丘 is Qinqiu, the poor fief in the Sunshu Ao allusion, not Qufu. The proposed idiomatic replacement restores the place and the point of comparison.
寢丘 functions as the place-name Qinqiu in this allusion, not the verbal phrase 'sleeping on a mound'; the proposed literal replacement is accurate.
累仞 means accumulating the mountain to many ren and supplies no numeral nine. The proposal removes a number imported from a related classical saying.

decisions.after: I answered, wiping away my tears: "I too have often heard the enlightened teaching concerning Pengzu and the short-lived, and the refined words of Wu's Prince of Yanling;
decisions.reason: 雪泣 means wiping tears, but the proposal still misreads 延吳 as two figures, 'Yan and Wu.' It abbreviates Wu's Prince of Yanling, Ji Zha; 彭殤 contrasts Pengzu with the short-lived.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 余雪泣而答曰：彭殤之達義，延吳之雅言

claimRetractions.reason: The alleged alternate name Yuan Yuling exists only because the English translation mistranscribed the surname 庾; the Chinese supports Yu Yuling and no Yuan alias.

knowledge of the various clans and their taboo names

claimRevisions.reason: The skill remains valid, but 百氏 denotes the various clans and 皆爲避諱 concerns observing their taboo names, not mastering a fixed set of one hundred surnames.
The personal-name fact is valid but its English value must agree with the explicit surname 庾 and the already correct pinyin: Yu Yuling, not Yuan Yuling.
